decision: Evaluate one bounded exact-kernel invocation repair. Reused development remained slower than EPLB-off in all four groups; this is not a demonstrated speedup or deployment recommendation.
changes: Warm and bind both exact unchanged int32/int64 Triton compiled kernels once.
Preserve actual native gate/topk and combining weights, input checks, fixed map, native expert alignment/allocation/GEMM geometry and output reduction.
Use bound compiled launchers with explicit constructing stream; check pointer alignment and reject unsupported JIT hooks/global dependencies.

diagnostic_basis.scope: Four reused pilot groups; exact physical-ID replay only a diagnostic; input checks had no consistent benefit.

development_basis.scope: Four reused pilot groups, two reverse technical repetitions. Descriptive only; no confidence intervals.

limits: Exact pinned Triton3.7.1 and SM90 compiled signatures; fixed B128/top8/map only.
Sequential constructing stream; no concurrent reuse, graphs or deployment integration.
Native full expert-kernel launch extent retained; rejected trim result preserved.
Keep prior5%response useful-gain criterion and2%regression margins unchanged.
